t: You're looking at the great dome on the Greenwich Peninsula, originally called the Millennium Dome. It was built to house an exhibition celebrating the start of the third millennium, and when it opened in 1999 it was the fifth largest building in the world by usable volume. The exhibition ran through the year 2000, but drew barely half the twelve million visitors its sponsors expected, and the press called it a failure. The architect was Richard Rogers, a British and Italian architect known for high-tech, modernist design.
